title: Benefits to Wildlife from Reduction in Frequency of Green Verge Maintenance along Public Roads and Paths during COVID-19 Circuit Breaker
what_it_is: Benefits to Wildlife from Reduction in Frequency of Green Verge Maintenance along Public Roads and Paths during COVID-19 Circuit Breaker

sections.label: Naturalistic landscapes and greenery maintenance
sections.summary: NParks will curate more naturalistic landscapes and Nature Ways, scale up green verge maintenance, and encourage mechanised greenery maintenance work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: They make paths cooler and more comfortable for users, and facilitate the movement of birds and butterflies between green spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These measures have benefited the environment and biodiversity, and reduced the frequency of greenery maintenance needed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to identify more sites to be curated and managed as naturalistic landscapes, and implement more Nature Ways.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: But even in such settings, there will still be a need for regular maintenance, especially for public health and safety reasons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: They also pose a fire risk during prolonged periods of dry weather.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Hence, NParks will gradually scale up maintenance along green verges as the circuit reaker measures are eased.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will also continue to encourage productivity in the greenery maintenance sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Such work is increasingly being mechanised and innovative technologies are being applied to reduce the need for manual labour.
